subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway 40B Development
overview: The board elected a new chair and continued the public hearing for a 350-unit comprehensive permit development at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway. Discussions focused on construction management, site operations, and responding to civil engineering peer reviews.

items.title: Election of Chair
items.summary: The board elected Mike Caldera to serve as the Chair of the Zoning Board of Appeals.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Case 40B-2022-01
items.summary: The applicant presented responses to the civil engineering peer review, detailing a construction management plan that utilizes mobile hydraulic cranes and handles materials on-site. The board reviewed operational logistics for the eight-story building, including a one-way drive aisle, a truck lay-by area for scheduled move-ins, and off-site snow removal for major storms.

items.title: Statutory Timeline and Procedural Waivers
items.summary: The board clarified that the 180-day hearing deadline expires at the end of May and discussed a procedural waiver from the local wetlands ordinance since the project requires state-level Conservation Commission review. Peer reviewers requested that future responses be submitted on the applicant's letterhead to clarify the record.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Public comment was opened and then closed after no members of the public spoke regarding the civil engineering responses.
